text:
Here is the step-by-step reasoning for each problem:

**[id 90]**
Adults eat 10 lbs each. 20 adults * 10 lbs = 200 lbs.
Children eat half (5 lbs) each. 5 children * 5 lbs = 25 lbs.
Total potato salad = 200 + 25 = 225 lbs.

**[id 91]**
Cindy has 4 pets.
Marcia has 2 more than Cindy: 4 + 2 = 6 pets.
Jan has 3 times as many as Marcia: 6 * 3 = 18 pets.
Total pets = 4 + 6 + 18 = 28 pets.

**[id 92]**
James is 10.
James is 1 year younger than Corey, so Corey is 11.
Amy is 2 years younger than Corey, so Amy is 9.
Amy is 5 years older than Jackson, so Jackson is 9 - 5 = 4.

**[id 93]**
Lee runs the hurdles in 38 seconds. 
Lee used to be 2 seconds faster than Gerald, meaning Gerald used to run it in 38 + 2 = 40 seconds.
Gerald improved his time/speed by 10%: 40 seconds * 10% = 4 seconds off his time.
Gerald's new time = 40 - 4 = 36 seconds.

**[id 94]**
Dogs = 60.
Cats (two for every dog) = 60 * 2 = 120.
Combined dogs and cats = 60 + 120 = 180.
Rabbits (12 less than combined) = 180 - 12 = 168.
Total pets = 60 + 120 + 168 = 348.

**[id 95]**
Total students = 200.
Boys = 2/5 of 200 = 80.
Girls = 200 - 80 = 120.
Girls in girl scout = 2/3 of 120 = 80.
Girls NOT in girl scout = 120 - 80 = 40.

**[id 96]**
Harry slept 9 hours.
James slept 2/3 of what Harry slept: (2/3) * 9 = 6 hours.
Difference = 9 - 6 = 3 hours.

**[id 97]**
Final sauce volume = 32 ounces.
Since they lose half their volume, the initial volume of the canned tomatoes was 32 * 2 = 64 ounces.
Each can is 16 ounces, so she used 64 / 16 = 4 cans.
Each can has 3 tomatoes, so 4 * 3 = 12 tomatoes.

**[id 98]**
Total cars originally = 30.
Cars that took the exit = 5.
Cars that drove through the traffic jam = 30 - 5 = 25.
Cars that drove through in the remaining 15 minutes = 20.
Cars that drove through in the first 15 minutes = 25 - 20 = 5.

**[id 99]**
Mary received 18 new plants.
She had 2 plants on each of the 40 ledges: 2 * 40 = 80 plants.
Total plants before giving any away = 80 + 18 = 98 plants.
She gives away 1 plant from each of the 40 ledges (40 plants given away).
Remaining plants = 98 - 40 = 58.
